niche: Merchant of record (MoR) billing and payments platform for SaaS and digital product companies, handling global payments, subscription billing, tax/VAT compliance, and checkout on their behalf
target_audience: SaaS and software companies (from startups to mid-market and enterprise) selling digital products/subscriptions internationally that want to outsource payments, billing, and global tax compliance instead of building it in-house.
key_use_cases: Selling SaaS subscriptions and software licenses globally without setting up local tax entities
Automating recurring billing, invoicing, and dunning for subscription businesses
Handling checkout, payment methods, and currency localization for international customers
Managing sales tax/VAT compliance and remittance across multiple jurisdictions
